concepts.label: Image Alignment
concepts.one_sentence: Image alignment is the task of estimating the geometric transformation that relates one image to another transformed version.

motivation.text: We can also study the reverse problem where we have two images (one is a transformed version of the other) and the goal is to identify the transformation. This problem is called image alignment.
motivation.section: [SECTION: Implicit Image Representations › Image Warping with Implicit Representations]

example.text: The spatial transformer network is an example of using parametric image transformations inside a neural network. Such transformation can be helpful during learning to align the training examples into a canonical pose.
example.section: [SECTION: Implicit Image Representations › Image Warping with Implicit Representations]

concepts.label: Spatial Transformer Network
concepts.one_sentence: A spatial transformer network inserts a learnable parametric geometric warp into a neural network to help normalize or align inputs.

motivation.text: Such transformation can be helpful during learning to align the training examples into a canonical pose.
motivation.section: [SECTION: Implicit Image Representations › Image Warping with Implicit Representations]

example.text: The example shows an image encoded by a sinusoidal representation network (SIREN) and then reconstructed with a rotation of 45 degrees and a scaling by 0.5 along both dimensions.
